RULES:
A. General
The underlying policy premium is calculated separately for each purchased Coverage Part
(Directors, Officers and Entity Liability – "D&O," Educators Errors and Omissions Liability –
"E&O," and Employment Practices Liability – "EPL") and then combined. To determine the
premium for the Umbrella Rider, calculations are based on the underlying premium for each
purchased Coverage Part. An insured must purchase at least two of the three underlying
Coverage Parts with combined limits to be eligible for Umbrella Liability coverage.
B. Base Premium
1. Determine the premium for each Coverage Part purchased on the underlying policy.
2. Choose a limit for Umbrella Liability coverage. Add this limit to the underlying per claim
Limit of Liability (always $1 million) and find the combined increased limit factor (ILF) in
the table below. For example, an account with a $1 million underlying limit purchasing
$10 million Umbrella Liability coverage has a 2.11 combined ILF (corresponding to the
$11 million value in the table below).
